stages.label: ss-fit rw

reasons: 16 sampling gap(s) exceeded 27ms; motion during those gaps was not judged

findings: tight control: button.rw-button "Add comment" sits 6.4px under div.rw-tabs "BrowserMockupBrief"; a button keeps 8px or more from the field, line or card edge above it (open, capture)

small text: button.rw-button "Add comment" renders at 9.3px on a phone; the floor is about 10px, so lay compact out at the column's width and set its type for it, not shrunk from the wide design (open, capture)
layout: button is 27px high but its content, padding and borders need 28.9px (24 frames from open)
layout: div.rw-capture-hint leaves 10px below its last child inside div.rw-capture-hint, short of its 14px bottom padding (open, capture, pin)
tight control: button.rw-quiet "Return to live" sits 7.4px under div.rw-tabs "BrowserMockupBrief"; a button keeps 8px or more from the field, line or card edge above it (capture +0.7s, pin)

small text: span "1 · On this capture" renders at 9.3px on a phone; the floor is about 10px, so lay compact out at the column's width and set its type for it, not shrunk from the wide design (8 frames from pin +0.7s)

clipped: near aligned: span.ss-swap__in "Pin 1 · “It works on my " and span "Feedback goes to the tea" start 5.5px apart in aside.rw-discussion; lines in a card share one left edge, or one is indented on purpose by a column (an avatar's width and gap), never by a few pixels (complete, complete +0.7s, end 16.53s)

steps in its box: button.rw-quiet "Return to live" moves by layout, so its text snaps to whole pixels while the box glides, and hops inside it as it lands; give it or a parent a lasting layer (will-change: transform), and glide it by a transform

appears with no entrance: svg.lucide.lucide-arrow-left shows at full size and opacity in one frame; fade it in, or grow it out of what it comes from (a chip budding off a value scales from it as it fades in: Fly with held), never pop it in whole
vanishes with no exit: svg.lucide.lucide-message-square goes from full opacity to gone in one frame; fade it out (or move it out of view) before it is removed

handoff shift: svg.lucide.lucide-camera replaces an identical element that was last drawn 0.0px across, 1.6px down and -0.8x-0.8px larger, so it visibly snaps on the swap; measure the element that lands (rect() on it, not its container) and swap on a frame where both are identical
manual: same-box content change: textarea changes text or drawing at 4.18s [pin]; inspect the transition in motion (geometry alone cannot judge it)
